description: One d4 sub-table per location. All four entries of a location share that location's interior art.

entries.name: the Net Loft
entries.title: Net Loft
entries.arrival: Up a crooked stair, the net loft glows with lamplight and the smell of tar and rope.

entries.name: the Chandler's Back Room
entries.title: Chandler's Back Room
entries.arrival: Behind barrels of lamp oil, a warm back room offers a long table and a banked fire.

entries.name: the Tidewatch Lamp Room
entries.title: Tidewatch Lamp Room
entries.arrival: At the top of the Tidewatch Light, the great lamp turns and throws gold across the water.

entries.name: the Old Boathouse
entries.title: Old Boathouse
entries.arrival: Inside the old boathouse, upturned skiffs make a shadowed hall around one hanging lantern.

entries.name: the Charcoal-Burners' Hut
entries.title: Charcoal-Burners' Hut
entries.arrival: The hut's low door opens on a banked hearth, drying herbs and the scent of woodsmoke.

entries.name: the Woodcutters' Lodge
entries.title: Woodcutters' Lodge
entries.arrival: The lodge is all timber beams and firelight, with antlers over a wide stone hearth.

entries.name: the Hermit's Cabin
entries.title: Hermit's Cabin
entries.arrival: A tiny cabin hides among the pines, one thread of candlelight leaking past its shutters.

entries.name: Pilgrims' Rest
entries.title: Pilgrims' Rest
entries.arrival: Pilgrims' Rest is a long, low hall of whitewashed stone, its benches warm from a roaring fire.

entries.name: the Windward Waystation
entries.title: Windward Waystation
entries.arrival: The waystation's heavy door shuts out the wind, and a roaring hearth floods the hall with gold.

entries.name: the Shepherds' Bothy
entries.title: Shepherds' Bothy
entries.arrival: The bothy is little more than stone and turf, but its stove glows and the kettle sings.

entries.name: the Muleteers' Inn
entries.title: Muleteers' Inn
entries.arrival: The inn rings with low talk, wet boots steaming before a crowded hearth.

entries.name: the Cairn House
entries.title: Cairn House
entries.arrival: The Cairn House is a squat stone refuge, its long table lit by a single iron lamp.

entries.name: the Tin Street Tea House
entries.title: Tin Street Tea House
entries.arrival: Paper screens glow around the tea house, where steam rises from a dozen small cups.

entries.name: Brannock's Apothecary
entries.title: Brannock's Apothecary
entries.arrival: Jars of dried petals and amber syrups crowd the apothecary's shelves, glowing in the lamplight.

entries.name: the Puppet Theater
entries.title: Puppet Theater
entries.arrival: Behind the little stage curtain, painted faces watch from a lamplit shelf.

entries.name: the Lantern-Maker's Shop
entries.title: Lantern-Maker's Shop
entries.arrival: In the lantern-maker's shop, a hundred unlit lamps hang like sleeping fruit.

entries.name: the Caretaker's Lodge
entries.title: Caretaker's Lodge
entries.arrival: The lodge is small and tidy, with a kettle on the stove and keys hanging in neat rows.

entries.name: the Chapel of Quiet Bells
entries.title: Chapel of Quiet Bells
entries.arrival: In the chapel, candles burn before a wall of silent bronze bells.

entries.name: the Undercroft Study
entries.title: Undercroft Study
entries.arrival: Down a short stair, the undercroft study smells of beeswax, old paper and cold stone.

entries.name: the Vestry
entries.title: Vestry
entries.arrival: The vestry is warm and cluttered with robes and candle stubs, and a lamp glows on the table.

entries.name: the Stilt House
entries.title: Stilt House
entries.arrival: The stilt house sways softly over dark water, lamplit and hung with drying reeds.

entries.name: the Heron Shrine
entries.title: Heron Shrine
entries.arrival: Inside the shrine, lanterns shaped like herons light a floor of polished boards.

entries.name: the Eel-Catchers' Hall
entries.title: Eel-Catchers' Hall
entries.arrival: The hall smells of smoke and river mud, and every beam is hung with lanterns and baskets.

entries.name: the Ferryman's Hut
entries.title: Ferryman's Hut
entries.arrival: The ferryman's hut is snug and low, with a stove, a rope bed and a lamp swinging overhead.

entries.name: the Farmhouse Kitchen
entries.title: Farmhouse Kitchen
entries.arrival: The farmhouse kitchen is bright with copper pans, a crackling fire and fresh-baked bread.

entries.name: the Old Hayloft
entries.title: Old Hayloft
entries.arrival: Up in the old hayloft, lanterns hang from the rafters over sweet-smelling bales.

entries.name: the Mill House
entries.title: Mill House
entries.arrival: In the mill house, great wooden wheels creak softly behind a table laid with bread and cheese.

entries.name: the Cider Cellar
entries.title: Cider Cellar
entries.arrival: Down in the cider cellar, casks line the walls and one warm lamp lights a crooked table.

entries.name: the Map Room
entries.title: Map Room
entries.arrival: In the map room, charts cover every table and a green-shaded lamp hums softly.

entries.name: the Binding Workshop
entries.title: Binding Workshop
entries.arrival: The bindery smells of paste and leather, with unfinished books lined up like sleeping birds.

entries.name: the Archivist's Study
entries.title: Archivist's Study
entries.arrival: The study is narrow and tall, its ladder-reached shelves lit by one bright reading lamp.

entries.name: the Reading Gallery
entries.title: Reading Gallery
entries.arrival: The gallery's balcony looks down over sleeping desks, and a single lamp burns on the rail.
